title: Impossible to conjugate or reflect an unknown quantum state via a unitary evolution
summary: The no-cloning theorem, the no-deleting theorem, and other no-go theorems play a crucial role in quantum mechanics and quantum information. In this paper, we show that it is impossible to conjugate or reflect an unknown quantum state or conjugate or reflect the bit-flip (the phase-flip) of an unknown state via a universally unitary evolution. We also indicate that the partial conjugating operations are not anti-unitary and it is impossible to universally partially conjugate an unknown state via a unitary evolution.
